title: The vocals were absolutely UNREAL #localtheatrespotlight #themuny #ch...
transcript: Welcome to a local theater spotlight. Today we are headed to Saint Louis, Missouri to check out chess at the Muni, located in the center of Forest Park. The Muni has produced theater in ST. Louis for over 100 years. Each summer the Meanie produces a season full of musicals filled with Broadway stars and members of the community at this beautiful outdoor venue which is not covered so rain will stop the show momentarily. Putting theater on for the community is such a big part of the Meanies message. They even offer a section of free seats at every single performance. Every single production that I've seen here has been such high quality, and even the production photos of the Little Shop puppets and Mary Poppins flying across the theater have been spectacular. And with only a week long run, every single show that they do feels incredibly special. They only do shows during the summer and they only have 2 shows left. Rent is currently playing and Sister Act will start next week. They currently have a survey up for their next years season. I'm currently rooting for Follies and waitress. If you are anywhere near ST. Louis, I cannot recommend the Muni enough.
